title: Challenges and Opportunities of NLP for HR Applications: A Discussion Paper

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and conceptual discussion of historical failures, specifically analyzing Amazon's AI recruiting tool that learned to reject female candidates due to a male-dominated training dataset.

Conceptual analysis discussing how automated resume screening could theoretically offer equal treatment regardless of applicant names (e.g., ethnic-sounding names), and reviewing the removal of photos/names to avoid bias.
Theoretical evaluation of how NLP hiring pipelines structurally disadvantage candidates whose resumes are written in under-resourced (low-density) languages compared to English.
